# CHD-3.5 lifecycle authoring evidence
**Authoring date:** 2026-11-11 **Scope:** lifecycle corrections only; no rendering; no kanban or memory writes.

## Inputs read
- `/home/kara/specs/coding-hermes-director/audit/astra-audit.md` - `/home/kara/specs/coding-hermes-director/build-spec/INTEGRATION.md` - `/home/kara/specs/coding-hermes-director/build-spec/gap-dispositions.json` - workspace CHD-3.3 lifecycle source and the three assigned narrative sections
The requested path `/home/kara/specs/coding-hermes-director/gap-dispositions.json` did not exist; the available authoritative file was `build-spec/gap-dispositions.json`, which was read.

## Exact edits
- `tables/lifecycle-35.json` — created the CHD-3.5 typed source for six distinct machines: logical send, attempt, run, wait, assignment, and objective. Added explicit enums, transition IDs, guards, owners, writes, external-effect ordering, report/gate policy, visibility-only ladder, capacity release proof rules, acceptance policy, negative cases, and OPEN integration limits. - `tables/section11-lifecycle-source.json` — replaced the contradictory CHD-3.3 source with a compatibility projection declaration. It now points to `lifecycle-35.json`, exposes only CHD-3.5 enums/policy, and identifies the concrete stop-proof producer as OPEN. - `scripts/lifecycle-35-generate.py` — created deterministic projection generator for schemas, transition/ladder/acceptance CSV tables, and a declarative figure model. It validates source state membership, ladder non-terminality, objective/assignment acceptance edges, and OPEN capacity proof producer before generating. - `scripts/lifecycle-35-validate.py` — created validation for source/projection state membership, projection count, visibility-only ladder, guarded non-composition acceptance, guarded assignment acceptance, and explicit OPEN capacity proof producer. - `schemas/lifecycle-35-*.schema.json` — generated one state schema per typed machine. - `tables/lifecycle-35-transitions.csv`, `tables/lifecycle-35-ladder.csv`, `tables/lifecycle-35-acceptance.csv` — generated projections. - `figures/lifecycle-35-figure-model.json` — generated declarative figure source; it is not rendered. - `src/10-story-master-flows.md` — updated revision/authority notice, replaced objective/assignment contradiction with typed guarded transitions and record ownership, and corrected acceptance/delivery narrative for explicit non-composition and composition paths. - `src/80-admission-dispatch.md` — updated revision/authority/safety rules, capacity dimensions, lease-expiry semantics, SEND operation/write ordering, wait/timeout/cancellation semantics, and worker run state example to remove non-canonical states. - `src/100-reports-acceptance.md` — updated revision/authority notice and replaced K.5 with distinct attempt/wait/assignment/objective guards, visibility-only ladder, and non-composition/composition acceptance rules.

## Decisions applied
- D-039 remains binding: this task did not alter restore policy. Archived policy is history; every restore/replacement resolves current permissions; same-profile fork defaults preserve-parent with current-policy as explicit alternative; live sessions do not auto-resync. - G-05: logical send, attempt, run, wait, assignment, and objective have separate enums, records, owners, and transitions. Unknown state outputs are invalid to projections. - G-06: report receipt, timeout, process exit, lease expiry, cancellation intent, and uncorrelated absence do not release capacity. Release requires trusted correlated terminal runtime proof or stop attestation. The concrete native/provider producer, transport, schema/version, and executable runtime traces remain OPEN. - G-14: `OB-03` is the guarded direct `objective.in_acceptance -> accepted` edge for `composition_required=false`; `AS-03` is the guarded assignment acceptance edge. Human gates, blocking sends, evidence, criteria, and runtime proof are explicit guards. Composition remains a separate guarded path.
